output.title: DNS response caching in FindZoneByFqdn: the environment doesn't show which code path is used
output.content: The release note only says that v1.18.0 caches the full DNS response and handles TTL expiration in `FindZoneByFqdn`. It doesn't say which cert-manager features use this function or how users would notice the change. The environment shows cert-manager v1.17.0 and `cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate` manifests, but it includes no Issuer or ClusterIssuer manifests, no solver configuration, and no values keys that show how certificates are validated. The CRD dimension is also marked absent. To decide, the operator should check their issuer and solver configuration against PR #7596 to see whether their setup uses `FindZoneByFqdn`.
